specification.name: grocery_sample
specification.scenario: Fictional independent grocery replenishment decisions; predict inventory pressure.
assumptions: Independent rows, no repeated store/item histories or temporal forecasting.
Inputs are sampled independently; business relationships are illustrative, not calibrated.
Classification uses a stochastic logistic outcome; regression is a signed pressure index, not demand units.
Inputs exist before the outcome; no IDs, future sales, or post-outcome indicators are predictors.

features.name: inventory_coverage
features.description: Inventory coverage at decision time, in days

features.name: recent_demand_index
features.description: Demand index calculated only from earlier observations
